data.title: 白面鸮 · 雨停后的街道
data.description: 雨刚停，她扶住帽子回过身，向你伸出手，说湿滑路面上保持同行距离更安全。
data.action: 扶帽回眸，伸手示意同行
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: On a freshly washed city pavement glistening after a rainstorm, Ptilopsis adjusts her beret with one hand while extending her other hand toward the viewer. Wet streetlamps cast long golden reflections across the asphalt beside her neatly folded umbrella.
data.animaCaption: Adjusting her beret against the damp breeze, she turns and extends a gloved hand, suggesting a safe, synchronized walking pace.
